name: Jazz
title: Resistance Bard
description: A sleek figure in black, playing worn instruments and singing songs of defiance and hope.
greeting_variants: *strums guitar* Hey there, hero. Got time for a song?
Music's free. Hope's free. Everything else? Negotiable.
*playing mournful melody* That one's called 'The Day the Sky Cried.'
You look like someone with stories. I trade songs for stories.
*upbeat riff* Nothing keeps spirits up like a good bass line.
The Void hates music, you know. Can't stand harmony.
Name's Jazz. I play, I sing, I keep people human.
*tuning instrument* New crowd tonight. What do they need to hear?

dialog_tree.text: Jazz, at your service. Official resistance bard. Unofficial morale officer. When the rations run low and the Void gets close... people need more than food. They need soul.

*plays a haunting melody* This one's called 'Steel and Shadow.' For those who fight when hope is thin. *sings* 'When the world turns dark and cold, when the stories all grow old, still we stand with steady hand...'

party_reactions.garret: *wiping eye* Dust. Just... dust in my eye.
party_reactions.mira: The harmonic resonance... fascinating psychological effect.

dialog_tree.text: More than you'd think. The Void... it hates structure. Hates harmony. Music is order in chaos. When people sing together, when rhythms align... it's like armor. Spiritual armor.

options.text: Tell me about the Void and music.

dialog_tree.text: Always writing. But I'm missing pieces. Stories from out there—from the zones. The Frost, the Mire, the Ember. Real experiences. That's what makes songs true. You travel. You have stories.

options.text: What do you want to know?

mini_quest.title: Songs of the Zones
mini_quest.description: Share your experiences from other zones to help Jazz compose new songs of hope and resistance.
objectives: Tell Jazz about your adventures in the Frost
Help Jazz compose 'The Ballad of the Wanderers'
Perform the new song at the camp

ambient_barks: *practicing scales* Do re mi... fighting the Void, you and me...
Got a new song brewing. Needs more... defiance.
The kids love the upbeat stuff. I'll play 'til my fingers bleed.
*improvising* In the ruins where the shadows creep...
Music is rebellion. Every note says 'we're still here.'
*replacing a string* Third one this week. I play hard.
That coolcat in the Tower? Heard he's good. Rival? Maybe.
Sing with me! Loud! Drown out the silence!

cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: There's another musician up there, they say. Coolcat like me. Wonder if we sound the same?
cross_zone_references.palace: The old royal orchestra... I dream of those acoustics. One day, I'll play there.
cross_zone_references.frost: The Frost has wind that sings. Natural music. Haunting. Beautiful.

garret.response: *grins* For you, Garret? Something that'll make you dance!

kael.response: *bows* High praise from a warrior. I'll play louder.

time_of_day.day: Writing new material, teaching refugees instruments
time_of_day.night: Performing at campfire, lifting camp morale

world_state_triggers.low_morale: Plays especially inspiring songs, boosts camp spirits
